question: Which provider assets and daily PriceUSD/CapMrktEstUSD histories are exposed on the authorized Community route, before changing any strategy universe or requesting new economic results?
authority: https://docs.coinmetrics.io/api/v4/ documents the public Community hostname, reference-data/assets and catalog-v2/asset-metrics. Catalog contents are current-provider coverage claims, not historical availability or exchange-asset identity proof.
identity_policy: Provider ticker equality is a candidate link only. Preserve full reference data and ambiguity; do not strip1000prefixes, stitch token migrations, map old/newPUMP or LIT by current names, or treat a current provider/exchange list as an original historical identity registry.
coverage_policy: Retain all native historically eligible contract slots in the denominator. A catalog interval is not proof that every required date has valid values. Missing/unmapped/unavailable items stay explicit, never zero or a smaller silently selected universe. No profitable-horizon or surviving-asset filtering.
